services.desc: Let us show you the top fishing spots on the lake and share the best fishing knowledge and tips from decades of fishing experience, allowing you to have an amazing trip and the best chances of catching the big one. Our customer service is second to none and YOU are top of mind when you are fishing with us! “We don’t just go fishing, we catch fish, share lake information, product information, and know how’s for tackle, gear, and methods”. We specialize in individual outings, family outings, team building, bachelor/bachelorette parties, birthday parties, corporate trips, and professional tournament prep trips and services.
